replicate_statements: The data are presented as mean ± SD. Statistical analysis involved Student's t‐test and one‐way ANOVA followed by post hoc Tukey's HSD (honestly significant difference) test.
outputs.explanation: Bar graphs with mean ± SD and statistical tests (t-test, ANOVA+Tukey) clearly involve replicated quantitative data, and an n-number ('N=4') is shown on the mitochondrial fraction graph. However, neither the panel nor the caption states what the replicates are (e.g., biological replicates/mice/independent experiments), so the replicate type is not reported.
Panel B shows representative immunoelectron microscopy images with no quantification or statistics, so no replicate reporting is required.
Panel C is a representative Western blot comparing purification methods with no quantification or statistical analysis, so replicate reporting is not required.
Panel D is a representative Western blot from the proteinase K protection assay with no quantification or statistics, so replicate reporting is not required.
